notes.title: weekly update 5/15
notes.content:
Regular update once a week.
The major changes are as follows.
<< Important: Relic bug fixes >>

* Refactoring of the save load system was carried out in order to deal with the freeze of relics associated with the previous version upgrade.
Due to the data structure change, the current save data relic information is reset.
If all of them are reset, the attack situation up to that point will be disadvantageous, so we responded as follows.

・ If you load from the save data of the previous version, start [/ u] from the state where you have [u] all the relics that can be obtained from the treasure box by the previous chapter. (The remains obtained from the random event will be reset.)
・ Data before getting relics, and if you proceed from new, will be processed as usual.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused to our customers who are already taking steps.

《Other bug fixes》

・ Correspondence of a bug that freezes with a certain chapter puzzle
-Fixed a bug that you cannot summon more than 5 cards in the next battle after maximizing summons with the summon limit increased.
・ Support for hunger and bugs that recover beyond the upper limit of magical power.
-Fixed a bug that the icon remained when the enemy was defeated with the condition abnormal

《Planned next regular update》

-Corresponding to display the passive display of the enemy with an icon.
・ Balance adjustment for normal battle.
In addition, we will respond to hand UI repairs that could not be done this time after the passive repair is over.





that's all. Thank you for your continued support, GAMES Before Sunset.

Development Yooza
